detailed_description:
The target video uses a live-action Korean studio-photography look with high-key diffused light, a clean pure-white palette and a shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] A tight close-up frames <Subject 1> from the shoulders up, slightly left of center against <Subject 3>. Her side-parted chestnut-brown waves fall over one shoulder, and the pastel-pink cable-knit cardigan of <Subject 2> is slipped off the opposite shoulder, showing the white lace-trimmed spaghetti strap and the small cream buttons. She lowers her gaze, then looks up into the lens with a gentle closed-lip smile; a loose strand of hair drifts across her cheek in a light breeze and her fingertips briefly touch the cardigan neckline. The camera pulls out with medium amplitude at slow speed, widening from the face to a waist-up composition that reveals the fitted waist of the white tulle skirt and her hands clasped in front of her. A faint fabric rustle and one soft breath are audible as the knit shifts.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the shot cuts to a centered full-body front view of <Subject 1> standing in <Subject 3>, with both cream flats visible and a faint shadow under them. <Picture 1> now takes effect as a viewpoint reference: she begins a slow, continuous turn to her right, passing through the exact side profile view with the cardigan's dropped shoulder and the skirt's layered flare, then reaching the full rear view in which her wavy hair falls down the back of the pink cardigan. The hem of the tulle skirt lifts and settles with the turn, and her hair sweeps across her shoulders before falling back. The camera arcs with small amplitude at slow speed in the same direction, keeping her whole figure inside the frame, and holds a static full-body rear composition for the final half second, matching the back-view panel of <Picture 1>. Soft tulle swishes and two light heel taps mark the turn. Face, hair, cardigan, camisole, skirt, flats, backdrop and lighting remain identical across both shots.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet studio room tone continues underneath a faint fabric rustle, one soft breath, the light swish of layered tulle and two muted heel taps on the smooth floor.
